purpose: An explicit clipboard action with a temporary success icon and optional notification.
behaviorProvider: Shared IconButton with the browser Clipboard API.

component: Write the supplied text with navigator.clipboard.writeText. Only after resolution show the check icon, change the action name to Copied, and call onCopy.
When notify is true, successful copy emits a success notification. Clipboard failure emits an error notification even when notify is false; no copied state is set on failure.
host: Provide copyable content through text and a contextual aria-label. Mount NotificationViewport for notification feedback.
Own permission decisions and sensitive-data policy. Clipboard availability depends on browser permissions and context.

Use trigger group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: No fallback copy implementation or onError callback is exposed.
The copied label and notification text are currently English. onCopy runs inside the clipboard try block; a thrown callback is treated as failure.
